Inner rail - inner chrome as a rule

set.outcome:
**Ten app shells, one grid** — `/imagine/shells/`, each at its own url, each hiding the site's chrome and bringing its own, each ending in a one-line verdict.

![](/framework/ai/2026-08-29/shells-lab/shots/canvas-1920.png)

**Outer chrome** — [Left rail](/imagine/shells/left/) - [Right rail](/imagine/shells/right/) - [Both rails](/imagine/shells/both/) - [Footer bar](/imagine/shells/foot/) - [Header + footer](/imagine/shells/head-foot/) - [Sidebar + footer](/imagine/shells/rail-foot/) - all six wrap the SAME document, so the chrome is the only variable.
**Canvas** - [Canvas centre](/imagine/shells/canvas/). **Inner chrome** - [Inner rail](/imagine/shells/inner-rail/) - [Inner status bar](/imagine/shells/inner-bar/). **Row** - [Chrome x columns](/imagine/shells/columns/).

### The findings

- **The six permutations are ONE grid.** A 3x3 of named areas; a part you do not declare costs an `auto` track of 0px. `Shell.css` has no per-shell rule at all.
- **A stage needs no arithmetic.** Chrome as `auto`, the surface as `minmax(0, 1fr)`: measured at 1920, 1920-208-208 = **1504** wide and 1080-52-40 = **988** tall, and the canvas prints its own readout.
- **Inner chrome is a RULE, outer chrome is a FILL** - same paper, a hairline, one type step down - and it navigates INSIDE its area. Chrome that changes the whole screen is the outer rail in disguise.
- **A footer and a full-height row share a shell only as the app's FLOOR** - spanning under the rail, content region clipped. A bar inside the content area under the row draws a second hairline 1px below the row's own.
- **A shell is not a column.** `column_host()` returns the SHALLOWEST columnar ancestor, so no nested columns host can ever win under `/imagine/` - `demo.app()` is the way, and a row inside a shell genuinely is a second tree.

### Sighting (pre-existing, not touched)

The site root `/page.js` wears `hides-nav` and the root is an `active-ancestor` on every route, so `.app:has(.page.hides-nav.active-ancestor)` matches everywhere: **the global `.nav` strip is hidden site-wide**, committed at HEAD. Verified cold on `/imagine/`.

### Left

- Whether a document in a shell should keep its left edge (~1170px of empty paper at 1920) or centre - the site's one-left-edge rule says keep; noted in `doc/decisions.md` for the owner.
- Whether core wants a word for "index, not rail": a columns-row index with a `previews()` wall gets core's child rows under it as well. This one overrides `column()`; `/imagine/vary/` and `/imagine/gallery/` have the same shape without it.

Docs: [readme](/imagine/shells/readme/) - [doc/decisions.md](/imagine/shells/doc/decisions.md). Verified headless at 400 / 1920 / 3440: zero console errors on 11 pages x 3 widths, no document scroll, every scroller wanted.
